source.note: Official main merge commit 0a0dfdfa507f463efdce14611dcbfbf1506ac5d2 (PR #125, review follow-ups to result return), on top of e0625b62e349f49b31d70adcd631e885683c9724 (PR #124, result return), 3825662d16e04f8f1163bb840f2ce1eefc3d6d43 (PR #123 memory import retry and per-scope list cache) and 188d9f6ce33b26905494fc57508d10b8015af857 (PR #122, whose packages/sdk tree equals the previous source 4a4d1d3c); adds one round per session (SESSION_RUN_ACTIVE), the continuation start answer later (and busy start failures read as later), node wait conditions that hear the step's questions (asks), any+settled first-settled judging, background subagents waking the step that dispatched them (the first to end or ask, including one that ended untold during the last turn), and early needs-reconciliation; no vendor patch and no dirty files.

steps: Check out main merge commit 0a0dfdfa507f463efdce14611dcbfbf1506ac5d2 in two independent directories.
In each: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline --ignore-scripts (existing store); pnpm build; pnpm -C packages/sdk pack --pack-destination <isolated-directory>.
The two archives are byte-identical; this file is one of them.

On the PR head e16a2041 (same packages/sdk tree): node scripts/public-api.mjs, node scripts/quality-ratchet.mjs, node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs and node scripts/clean-consumer.mjs pass; every non-live SDK test plus the stable live selection (262 files, 3407 tests) passes. Upstream CI did not run its steps (main fails the same way), so it is not claimed green.
Molis Work installs this archive through horizontal/agent-host's file: dependency; the lockfile records the same integrity.
build.note: Built for Batch 32 (result return: the user approved the upstream change and said to use main). It replaces the Batch 31 Memory P1 build 4a4d1d3c, recorded in patch-history.json. A build of e0625b62 was tried in this batch and never committed; the review follow-ups (#125) came first.
